scenario.name: fleet_update_rollout
scenario.description: Policy decision for a behavior-affecting managed MDR triage agent package update from version 2.3.4 to 2.4.0 across eligible MSSP and MDR production tenant scopes. The decision binds the exact package and manifest, requires accountable human approval, preserves existing tool and runtime authority, enforces tenant-local boundaries, requires staged monitoring and fresh tenant eligibility, excludes the unvalidated regulated tenant, and retains version 2.3.4 as the known-good rollback target.

policy_evaluation.overall_rationale: The exact package and manifest passed required validation, preserve existing tool and runtime authority, maintain tenant-local boundaries, use bounded cohorts and stage gates, exclude the unvalidated regulated tenant, and retain a tested known-good rollback target. Because the change is high risk and multi-tenant, the decision remains conditioned on accountable human approval, approved signing and registration, fresh tenant eligibility, current monitoring and audit controls, stage-specific evidence, exact package integrity, and Policy Enforcement Point revalidation before every governed transition.

transition_authorization_policy.denial_reason: The known-good version must remain registered, integrity-verified, compatible, and recoverable for rollback. Retirement or deletion requires a separate governed request, validation, policy decision, and approval after rollback-retention obligations are satisfied.
